root_cause: Replicated fragment-index cleanup performs repeated poorly indexed analysis-history probes, blocking state-machine apply beyond the serving-proof budget.

wal_correlation.method: Read HQL_WAL records and inspect SQL bytes for last_applied_index + 1; no bind values retained.

benchmark.engine: SQLite 3.53.2 compiled from pinned libsqlite3-sys 0.38.1 amalgamation; Python driver preloaded only for the reproduction
benchmark.method: Consistent read-only snapshot of six tables, explicit indexes and matching sqlite_stat1/stat4 rows into private :memory: database; DELETE wrapped in BEGIN/ROLLBACK; 30-day cutoff, LIMIT 128; three trials per variant.
limitations: Not the daemon executable or an end-to-end Raft run.
Production triggers were listed but not copied. All measured deletes affected zero rows, so they would not execute row-trigger bodies.
Times exclude snapshot copy, migration/index construction, networking and disk commit.
VM step counts approximate in batches of 10000.
